passes.name: ab
passes.why: headroom and A/B (Redline M1, item 0): uncapped, every variant back to back at every stop, 3 rotated repeats, the first segment again at the end; as-was first, so every delta is against the build before B6

passes.name: capped
passes.why: reference (Redline M1): vSync on at the display, fullscreen window, 60 s a stop; a frame past 25 ms (1.5 refresh intervals at 60 Hz) missed its vblank. vSync on macOS paces frames 15.7-17.7 ms round 16.67 without missing one: the first run counted that jitter at 17.5 ms

passes.name: pan
passes.why: a moving camera and a level change (Redline section 6), uncapped

passes.name: counts
passes.why: machine-independent counts only (Aster, 2026-10-14: the Studio's timings say nothing of the Air): every variant at every stop, 1 s each, drawer per-view draws, SetPass, triangles, shadow casters and a shot; run with -perfNoWarm; frame times are not read

variants.name: as-was
variants.why: the build before B6 (ab-1's base): SSAO from the depth-normals prepass, 4 cascades, every LOD casts

variants.name: base
variants.why: as built (since B6: SSAO from depth after opaques, 2 cascades, LOD1 shadow proxies)

variants.name: ssao-depth
variants.why: Redline fix 1 alone on as-was: SSAO after opaques from the depth texture, no depth-normals prepass

variants.name: proxies
variants.why: Redline fix 2 alone on as-was: kit facades and street trees cast from their LOD1 proxy, no LOD casts its own

variants.name: cascades-2
variants.why: Redline fix 3 alone on as-was: one air cascade and the street band

variants.name: fixes-13
variants.why: fixes 1 and 3 without the proxies: what the proxies add on top of them

variants.name: fixes-123
variants.why: fixes 1-3 named switch by switch (equals base since B6; the guard that base is what ships)

variants.name: ssao-off
variants.why: as-was without SSAO: what SSAO costs at all

variants.name: fade-off
variants.why: Redline item 9 on as-was: what the fade's discard variant costs

variants.name: shadows-off
variants.why: bound on as-was: what the play camera's shadows cost at all
